text:
Tessa (CS): Hey team - captured 19 discrete asks from last 2 onboarding waves. Most common: per-tenant embedding quotas, unclear per-route billing, and console discoverability. Need a quick triage. Reactions: :white_check_mark: roadmap candidate, :mag: needs research, :rotating_light: churn risk

billing-bot: Uploaded onboarding_feedback_2026_06_02.csv (19 rows). Auto-tags: per-route-billing, quotas, docs, console-ux.

Aron (PM): Can we split by "quick-win" vs "requires infra"? quick-wins go in the next sprint if low effort.

Leah (Product Ops): Added columns: effort_guess, infra_flag, cs_note. Shared sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/triage-1788882468 (placeholder)

Tessa (CS): Pasting 4 samples from the sheet for visibility:
```
customer,tier,ask
ClearHarbor,A,per-tenant embedding quota so teams don't blow budget
SummitHealth,A,explain per-route billing in invoices (weird rounding differences)
OrbitApps,B,UI affordance to pin model version per-route
SmallKit,C,examples in docs for cache TTL and prefix caching
```

Kofi (Eng): per-tenant quota is mostly policy + billing enforcement. We need a short design doc for quota semantics (hard limit vs soft alerts). I can draft it.

Aron (PM): Reacting :white_check_mark: for ClearHarbor if quota can be enforced without infra redesign. SummitHealth looks like docs + invoice mapping, low effort.

Tessa (CS): marking SummitHealth and ClearHarbor as :rotating_light: churn risk 1 both mentioned billing surprises during contract review.

support-bot: Note: 6 accounts flagged as "follow-up ASAP" during import: ClearHarbor, SummitHealth, NovaRetail, FleetOps, BrightBridge, OrbitApps.

Leah (Product Ops): I'll schedule a 25-min triage tomorrow 2:00pm PT. Agenda: 1) quota semantics for ClearHarbor, 2) invoice/rate-card mapping for SummitHealth, 3) quick UX for pin-by-route. Invite: @Aron @Kofi @Tessa

Kofi (Eng): For pin-by-route: runtime already supports aliasing, UX is the blocker. Low effort backend + small console work. Estimate: 2 backend days + 2 frontend days.

Aron (PM): Good. We'll propose a small demo to OrbitApps as a pilot.

Tessa (CS): process note: can Eng/PM call out any asks that are absolute "no" (privacy/regulatory) so CS stops promising timelines? We had one ask about exporting raw customer prompts in per-route billing view.

Kofi (Eng): absolute no on exporting raw prompts. For billing views, only aggregated metrics and route IDs allowed. We'll call out export field whitelist.

Leah (Product Ops): I'll add a "privacy check" column to the sheet and mark exports for legal review.

Aron (PM): After triage, I'll convert roadmap picks into epics and attach ARR + CS risk notes. Leah please capture decisions in sheet.

Tessa (CS): thanks. I'll ping the A-tier CSMs to say we have a triage scheduled and we'll follow up. Follow-up items after triage: 1) Kofi drafts quota semantics doc, 2) Leah writes invoice mapping doc, 3) Aron creates epics for ClearHarbor + OrbitApps.

support-bot: Reminder: please include sample invoices or screenshot when flagging billing asks to speed investigation.

Tessa (CS): attaching SummitHealth invoice example to the sheet now. Will update here after triage. :thumbsup:
